name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and Apple Reminders with system-language widget text, locale-aware absolute dates, and icon-based completion in every widget size.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.3.4 follows the iPhone language and date locale across every widget, removes the duplicate icon from the small header, and replaces relative or live countdowns with absolute dates.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.3.4 让所有小组件跟随 iPhone 系统语言和日期格式，去掉小号左上角的重复图标，并以明确日期取代相对天数及实时倒计时。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.3.4 让所有小组件跟随 iPhone 系统语言和日期格式，去掉小号左上角的重复图标，并以明确日期取代相对天数及实时倒计时。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.3.4 讓所有小工具跟隨 iPhone 系統語言和日期格式，移除小號左上角的重複圖示，並以明確日期取代相對天數及即時倒數。
